Data sources in the model
Risk index = severity-weighted incidents with exponential time decay, shrunk toward the city mean (empirical Bayes), scaled 0–100 against the busiest station. Heat = Gaussian kernel density over incident locations.

Patrol planner

Adjust cars and staff on duty

Patrol units

Routes cluster each station's weighted incident points with k-means (one cluster per available car), then order stops by nearest neighbour from the station. Travel time assumes 20 km/h patrol speed plus 5 min per stop.

Ask the map

Questions are parsed on this device into a crime type, time of day, period, station and intent. The map filters, zooms and highlights to match the answer.

Live intelligence

The simulator draws new incidents from the model's own forecast for the current shift. They are tagged SIM and update the heatmap, rankings, patrols and surge alerts as they arrive. Real data enters through the Data tab.
